caption: The drawing is a monochromatic illustration that depicts the front facade of a building structured in a geometric and symmetrical style, rendered in shades of gray and black on an off-white background. The building has a triangular pediment at the top, with a small, rectangular window centered within the pediment. The roof and upper portion are illustrated with diagonal lines that convey a textured or shingled effect. Below the pediment, there is a rectangular section, with two prominent columns flanking a large, central arched doorway that casts a dark shadow within the entry. The lower half of the columns is shaded to suggest a cylindrical shape, and there are architectural details like molding above the doorway and at the capitols of the columns. Towards the bottom of the drawing, there are two banners: the smaller banner on the left reads "1791" and the larger banner beneath the building reads "mission de santa cruz" in a handwritten style, with a small signature "sjones" located at the end of the banner.
title: Mision de Santa Cruz
